signal: SoftPro launched ClosingsLIVE, a communication portal for tracking closing status and sharing documents, and was named a 2026 Best Place to Work

email.body1:
Patrick, saw SoftPro launch ClosingsLIVE and land on the 2026 Best Places to Work list.

New product opens conversations across title and escrow professionals, usually more accounts in-market than the team can cover at once. As the leader over both sales and marketing, that's pipeline left on the table. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for SoftPro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Patrick, quick follow-up for SoftPro.

A product launch spikes interest, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late and marketing spend lands on a thin top of funnel.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings SoftPro needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Patrick, last bit of proof for SoftPro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how SoftPro's reply rate likely compares to peer real-estate-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Patrick, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching new product across sales and marketing is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a real-estate-tech motion? I'll tailor it to SoftPro either way.
